title: Niall Horan Surprises Off Campus Star with Secret Duet!
summary: Imagine recording a song for your TV show, and then finding out a huge pop star secretly sang on it with you! That's exactly what happened to Ella Bright, who plays Hannah on the hit series Off Campus. The show just released a special soundtrack, and the team behind it pulled off an amazing surprise: they got Niall Horan, from One Direction, to turn Ella's solo cover of "Baby Now That I Found You" into a duet—without telling her! They filmed her reaction, and it's pure joy. In the clip, Niall says, "You don't know this yet, but you're about to listen to our version." Ella gasps and later compares it to his song "This Town," which is her favorite. "I'm obsessed. That's so beautiful," she says. In Off Campus, music is a huge part of Hannah's life—she even writes about One Direction's harmonies! The show's author, Elle Kennedy, says Ella is "magnetic" and brings Hannah's love for music to life. This duet is Niall's first release since his album Dinner Party earlier this year. Talk about a dream come true!
why_it_matters: It shows how hard work and sharing your talents can lead to unforgettable surprises and new friendships.
